name: Sharp Top (Peaks of Otter)
summary: Sharp Top fire lookout at the Peaks of Otter, Bedford County, VA: a 1938 photo shows a wooden watchtower above a stone shelter; the lookout has been removed, and a hiking guide mentions a stone shelter on the summit.
design: Wooden watchtower rising above a stone shelter on the summit (1938 photograph)
status_note: Forest Lookouts marks it Removed; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Tower Gone; an undated hiking guide mentions a stone shelter on the summit
agency: Virginia Department of Forestry (per Forest Lookouts)

access.note: Summit reached by a 1.5-mile National Park Service trail; NPS lists parking and a trailhead at the site

visit.trail_note: Sharp Top Trail, 1.5 miles and 1,300 vertical feet to the summit (NPS); no source says whether the stone shelter is open

events.note: Photograph dated October 29, 1938 shows a stone shelter and the lower part of a wooden watchtower on the summit
